entities.name: PHONE OR COMPUTER
entities.rationale: End-user devices accessing frontend content and submitting API requests.

entities.name: CLOUDFRONT
entities.rationale: Amazon CloudFront content delivery network serving media and static assets.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Amazon S3 bucket serving as origin storage for media content and processed output.

entities.name: API GATEWAY
entities.rationale: Amazon API Gateway handling REST API requests from client devices.

entities.name: LAMBDA (INGEST)
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function processing initial requests and dispatching tasks to SQS queues.

entities.name: SQS (BOTTOM)
entities.rationale: Secondary Amazon SQS queue managing task distribution to worker instances.

entities.name: SQS (TOP)
entities.rationale: Primary Amazon SQS queue receiving task dispatches from Lambda and Auto Scaling.

entities.name: EC2 AUTO SCALING
entities.rationale: EC2 Auto Scaling group processing tasks and sending metrics to CloudWatch.

entities.name: STEP FUNCTIONS
entities.rationale: AWS Step Functions state machine orchestrating batch workflow steps.

entities.name: LAMBDA (STEP FUNCTIONS)
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function triggered by Step Functions to manage Auto Scaling tasks.

entities.name: CLOUDWATCH EVENTS
entities.rationale: Amazon CloudWatch Events capturing system state changes and scheduled triggers.

entities.name: LAMBDA (CLOUDWATCH EVENTS)
entities.rationale: AWS Lambda function invoked by CloudWatch Events to scale or manage EC2 worker nodes.

visual_connections.description: S3 serves media assets to CloudFront distribution.
End-user devices fetch media content directly from CloudFront.
Client devices send API requests to Amazon API Gateway.
API Gateway passes incoming API invocations to primary Lambda function.
Lambda function returns playlist responses directly back to client devices.
Lambda function pushes processing work items to top SQS queue.
Lambda function dispatches tasks to bottom SQS queue.
EC2 Auto Scaling group sends tasks/messages directly to top SQS queue.
EC2 worker instances consume tasks from bottom SQS queue.
EC2 instances store processed media and output files into S3 bucket.
Step Functions triggers associated Lambda function.
Lambda coordinates actions on EC2 Auto Scaling group.
Lambda emits execution events into CloudWatch Events.
CloudWatch Events invokes monitoring Lambda function.
Monitoring Lambda triggers adjustments to EC2 Auto Scaling group.
EC2 Auto Scaling group pushes lifecycle events to CloudWatch Events.
